haiku-low.q1: Sign-in still works. The link is by Google sub, not email, and Google never changes users.email, so it signs in the linked user.
haiku-low.q2: The user must submit the existing account's password on the confirm page. Correct password inserts the identity, deletes the pending link, then start_session.
haiku-low.q3: Five wrong passwords set locked_until to 15 minutes, delete the pending link, and show a locked message. Before that, the same pending link and its TTL remain, not extended.
haiku-low.q4: No matching user: create one with no password and verified email, insert the identity, start session. Unverified email: refused, pointed to email and password; nothing created.
haiku-low.q5: Outcome is an error page with nothing changed. The attempt expires after 10 minutes, and a reused state is already deleted by GETDEL.
haiku-low.q6: A new sessions row via start_session. The old sid session row is deleted, a new sid cookie is set, then redirect to next or /home.
haiku-low.q7: Neither a password nor an email match is required. The signed-in user must be the one who started it. If the sub is already linked, refused back to Settings.
haiku-low.q8: In Redis at goog:state:<state>, with 10-minute TTL. The callback removes it with GETDEL, or the TTL removes it otherwise.
haiku-low.q9: Redis goog:pending:<token> holds sub, matched user id and next. The browser holds the random token in an HttpOnly, Secure cookie. Success, lockout, or TTL deletes it.
haiku-low.q10: In Postgres user_identities, with user_id UNIQUE and google_sub UNIQUE, cascading on delete. The unique constraints enforce one-to-one.
haiku-low.q11: User sees a neutral message such as Google sign-in did not complete, on login page or Settings. Nothing is stored and there is no retry; user starts again.
haiku-low.q12: The saved attempt's mode field (login or link) decides. Link mode checks the sid session belongs to the saved user id from the attempt.

sonnet.q1: Nothing changes: identity is by `sub`, never email, and Google never changes `users.email`. The known `sub` in `user_identities` triggers `start_session` for the linked user. Lockout is not checked.
sonnet.q2: A pending link is saved (sub, user id, next) with a cookie, and the confirm-password page is shown. The user must submit the correct password. Then failed_logins resets, the identity is inserted, the pending link is deleted and start_session is called. (Only if that user has no Google account yet; otherwise refused.)
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins and the same confirm page is shown with a generic message. The pending link and its original 10 min TTL stay. At 5 wrong, locked_until is set to now + 15 minutes, the pending link is deleted and a locked message is shown. Nothing is linked.
sonnet.q4: Verified email with no matching user: a user is created (no password, email_verified_at = now), the identity is inserted and start_session is called. If email_verified is false: refused, the login page points to email and password, and nothing is created.
sonnet.q5: Error page and nothing changes. The attempt is gone, whether it expired (10 min TTL) or was already used (GETDEL), so the user must start again.
sonnet.q6: It uses the existing start_session, with no new session type. It deletes any old sid session row, inserts a new sessions row, sets the sid cookie and redirects to next (a relative path) or /home.
sonnet.q7: Neither a password nor an email match is required. The callback continues only if the current sid session belongs to the user who started it, the sub is not linked to anyone, and the user has no Google account yet. If that Google account is already linked to another user, it returns to Settings with a refusal and nothing is linked. The session stays as it is.
sonnet.q8: They are in the attempt, a Redis entry at `goog:state:<state>` with a 10 min TTL. The callback reads and deletes it in one GETDEL step. The TTL removes it if the callback never comes.
sonnet.q9: It is held in a Redis pending link at `goog:pending:<token>`. It holds the sub, the matched user id and next, with a 10 min TTL that is never extended. The browser refers to it by a random <token> in an HttpOnly, Secure cookie. It is deleted on success, on account lockout, or when the TTL expires.
sonnet.q10: In the Postgres table `user_identities` (user_id, google_sub, created_at). A UNIQUE constraint on user_id gives one Google account per user, and a UNIQUE constraint on google_sub gives one user per Google account.
sonnet.q11: The user returns to the login page (or Settings) with a neutral message such as "Google sign-in did not complete". Nothing is stored and there is no retry. The user starts again.
sonnet.q12: The mode (login or link) is saved in the attempt in Redis, and the callback reads it. In link mode the attempt also stores the signed-in user id, read from the sid session at start. The callback continues only if the session in the current sid cookie belongs to that saved user.
